title: 6-1-26 County Launches WorkReady Hub
description:
County leaders and 211 launch new website as one stop shop for work, job training, educational and volunteer resources related to new federal changes affecting CalFresh and Medi-Cal eligibility.

To see auto-generated English captions during this livestream, click on the "cc" icon in the YouTube player.
